title: Finite pro-etale smooth base change
statement:
Use the finite coefficient conventions [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]: $\Lambda$ is a finite discrete commutative ring, $N\geq1$, $(N:\Lambda)=0$, and $N$ is invertible on $S$. Let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
Y&\xrightarrow{e}&T\\
h\downarrow&&\downarrow g\\
X&\xrightarrow{f}&S
\end{array}
$$
be a cartesian square [sbc-def-base-change-square] of noetherian schemes (each admits a finite affine open cover by spectra of rings in which every ideal is finitely generated), with $f$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and $g$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. On every pro-etale corner $W$, use the constant coefficient ring $\Lambda_{W,\Proet}$ and the category $\Dbc(W_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with the canonical structure isomorphisms of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Use the ordinary, uncompleted operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For every $K\in\Dbc(T_{\Proet},\Lambda)$, the canonical ambient ringed exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]
$$
F_K:Lf^*_{\Proet}Rg_{*,\Proet}K\longrightarrow Rh_{*,\Proet}Le^*_{\Proet}K
$$
is an isomorphism in $D(X_{\Proet},\Lambda)$. For any etale model $L\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and isomorphism $\alpha:\nu_T^*L\cong K$ supplied by [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], where $\nu^*$ is [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], it is obtained by conjugating the canonical etale exchange isomorphism of [sbc-thm-bounded-derived-smooth-base-change] by the canonical site-comparison isomorphisms and $\alpha$. No boundedness or constructibility of either endpoint is asserted.

proof.text: Extract an etale model L and alpha from isBoundedConstructibleFiniteCoefficient. The explicit cohomological bounds give the canonical t-structure lower and upper bounds via DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and isLE_iff. For each cohomology sheaf, use Scheme.isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf (the existing source-library realization of the constructibility comparison) with the same stratification. This gives Etale.DerivedCategory.boundedConstructible and hence a bounded-below object L′.

proof.text: The chosen square gives IsPullback e h g p. Base-change stability makes h quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply comparison_derivedBaseChangeMap to any bounded-below etale model. Cancel the source comparison isomorphism to express the pro-etale exchange at the comparison image as source comparison inverse, image of the etale exchange, then target comparison. These are precisely baseChangeSourceComparisonIso and finiteSmoothTargetComparison; no further comparison-coherence result is required.

source.place: Conjugation identity T_L A(E_L)=Ex S_L; the explicit inverse/cancellation is elementary

proof.text: Naturality of derivedBaseChangeMap at finiteSmoothModelCoordinates alpha expresses the exchange at the inverse realization of K as the source functor applied to the inverse coordinates, the exchange at the comparison image, then the target functor applied to the coordinates. Functoriality and the inverse-hom identity prove this by cancellation. Substituting the preceding identity gives the displayed conjugation formula for every L and alpha; applying realization.map gives exactly the second conjunct.

source.place: Definition as a natural transformation; explicit naturality square and conjugation along an isomorphism

proof.text: For the model extracted in step 1, use the already proved source-library theorem Etale.isIso_baseChange_app_of_boundedConstructible_of_smooth, the bounded-below version of sbc-thm-bounded-derived-smooth-base-change. Positivity of N implies N is nonzero; the annihilator and unit conditions are the specified fields of IsSmoothBaseChangeCoefficients. Rewrite the pro-etale exchange using the conjugation formula. Every factor is an isomorphism, as are its images under bounded-below inclusion, site comparison, and realization. Typeclass inference supplies the first conjunct.
